producer_report.summary:
`athena score-jev --derive` now derives class labels from what happened after each introspection and appends them as `athena.class-label/1` records. I could not run it on the 187 real introspections, because this snapshot has no `records/` directory. The full test suite, `cargo fmt --check` and clippy with warnings denied all pass.

Root cause: the only labeling path was a person's `athena review`, which is opinion, so `score-jev` had no labeled cases.

**Schema**
- `Labeler` gains `evidence`.
- `ClassLabel` gains an optional `basis`, a list of `{kind, records, detail}`.
- Old labels without a basis still read.
- Validation: an evidence label needs a class and a basis that cites records, and a person's label may not carry a basis.

**Derivation (new `evidence_labels.rs`)**
- Retry outcome: a later job whose request is the proposed request, or `athena retry` of the job when the introspection seeds that retry. It landed, or was rejected or failed with its own introspection in the same class.
- Recurrence after prevention: an accepted proposal for the class landed after the introspection. Then either a later introspection in the class exists (it kept recurring), or none does over at least 5 closed jobs (it stopped).
- Same-cause findings: a critic or verifier finding on the same job shares at least 3 five-letter words, and a quarter of the cause's such words, with the cause text. For rejection or failure introspections the verifier's blocker and major findings are excluded, because the introspection was written from them.
- The label always names the recorded class and cites the records. Cases with no evidence stay unlabeled. If the kinds ever named different classes the case would stay unlabeled, but no kind can do that today.

**Precedence and idempotence**
- `newest_labels` now ranks a person's or stronger model's label above an evidence label, whichever is newer.
- A rerun writes nothing: same class and same basis means already derived.
- Records are only added, in one commit.

**Reporting**
- `score-jev` prints how many counting labels come from evidence, per kind, plus how many a review overrode.
- With `--derive` it also prints what the run wrote and left out.
- Below 10 test rows the existing message states the shortfall and gives no verdict.
- Run in this snapshot, which has no `records/`, `cargo run --bin athena -- score-jev` printed all zeros and "too few labeled cases: 0 in the test part ... at least 10 test cases are needed. No score and no verdict."
- On the real records the maintainer runs `athena score-jev --derive`.

**Docs**
- Added D137 to `docs/decisions.md` with alternatives and tradeoffs, and a CHANGELOG entry.
- Updated the `docs/records.md` schema row, the README command row, and a paragraph in `defaults-loop.md`.

**Limits** (also in D137)
- Every evidence label agrees with the recorded class, so evidence never produces `none` labels. Verdict item 3 (false-match rate) stays "not established" unless a person labels some `none` cases.
- The recurrence kind relies on the same model's class assignments, and the findings kind is plain word overlap. The basis quotes the finding so a reader can judge it.
- The thresholds (5 jobs, 3 words, a quarter share) are estimates.

open_issues: I did not run `athena score-jev --derive` on the real records: records/ is absent from my snapshot. The real derived count, per-kind counts, score and verdict still have to come from running it on the maintainer's repository.

Evidence labels only ever confirm the recorded class, never `none` or another class, so the labeled set cannot show Jev's false-match rate (verdict item 3 stays 'not established'). Judging a different class would need a person's review.

The recurrence kind relies on the same model's class assignments, and the findings kind is a plain word-overlap check. Thresholds (5 jobs, 3 words, a quarter share) are estimates, flagged as such in the code and in D137.
reading.rs gained a visibility change (`retry_introspection` is now pub(crate)). It is not in the brief's deliverable list but is needed to find the introspection that seeds an `athena retry`.
Beyond the brief's files I also edited README.md (the score-jev row) and docs/design/defaults-loop.md (one paragraph) so the docs match the new behavior.
mistakes: First draft of retry_vote used `closed_state(retry)?`, which would have aborted the whole retry search at the first unfinished retry; fixed to continue before any test ran.
Clippy flagged a sort_by that should be sort_by_key and a needless lifetime in a test helper; both fixed.
learnings: Records::load (committed tree) holds jobs, requests, outcomes, verifications, critiques, proposals and introspections, while labeled::read_inputs reads the working tree; `commit_records` updates the work tree, so score-jev sees freshly committed labels.

Retries are linked by request text: `athena retry` records 'try again on <job>' (`reading::retried_job`). The introspection that seeds a retry is the job's latest recorded Rejection or Failure one (`retry_introspection`, now pub(crate)).
The introspection model is shown the verifier's blocker and major findings for rejections and failures, so those findings are not independent evidence of its cause.
`cargo run` needs `--bin athena`: the workspace has two binaries (athena and xtask) and no default-run.
A request job's outcome record must carry totals or AnyRecord::parse refuses it, so fixtures that commit request-job outcomes must supply them.
desires: The real records/ directory, to run `athena score-jev --derive` and report the actual derived count, score and verdict.
A real introspection and job record sample, to tune the same-cause word-overlap thresholds and the 5-job stopping window instead of using estimates.
